expectedTruths: Population: PU = 0.60 PEOU + zeta; BI = 0.20 PEOU + 0.50 PU + zeta; indirect PEOU->BI = 0.60*0.50 = 0.30; total PEOU->BI = 0.50.
For every estimator and every bootstrap draw: total effect PEOU->BI = direct PEOU->BI + PEOU->PU * PU->BI (an algebraic identity of recursive linear models, to rounding).
Bootstrap with the same engine, configuration and seed reproduces identical draws and confidence intervals.
PU items use the high-agreement profile (thresholds shifted by -0.6), so their category distributions are shifted towards 7; all others use the symmetric profile.
Sample estimates on Likert data are compared engine-to-engine; the population values are targets only for consistent estimators on continuous data (see tam-mediation-exact).
purpose: Simulated TAM mediation: total = direct + indirect effects, bootstrap CI
statement: SYNTHETIC benchmark/teaching data generated by this repository; represents no real study.
title: TAM mediation (PEOU -> PU -> BI), 7-point Likert
